messages:
elaine: Quick sync — want to align on i18n + quota-hinting for client-facing errors as we roll out the new console UX. Short list: taxonomy, SDK contract, telemetry events, and fallback text for locales.

alex: +1. Do we prefer machine-translated fallbacks or defaulting to English with a docs link? :thinking_face:

priya: product preference is English fallback + short localized snippet for critical hints (e.g., quota exceeded). Always include a link to the docs for full details.

matt: from runtime side: we should also standardize the mapping between HTTP status and user_hint. Proposal: 400 -> validation, 401/403 -> auth, 409 -> conflict, 429 -> quota/rate-limit (include retry_after), 503 -> transient infra (no user retry by default).

julio: SDK needs a stable error envelope. Suggest fields: { code, http_status, user_message, developer_hint, retry_after_seconds, i18n_key }. Example: 
```json
{
  "code": "quota_exceeded",
  "http_status": 429,
  "user_message": "You have used your request quota for this minute.",
  "developer_hint": "Consider batching or upgrading reserved capacity.",
  "retry_after_seconds": 30,
  "i18n_key": "error.quota_exceeded.short"
}
```

alex: love that. For locales we store user_message in user's locale when available. If not available, show i18n_key -> docs link and fallback to english short message. Keep user_message <= 140 chars for the console inline hint.

priya: UX asks we also show a subtle "What's my quota?" link that opens the quotas pane. Click should emit telemetry hint_click=quota_link.

matt: adding telemetry names here: error_dispensed, hint_shown, hint_click, fallback_locale_used. Also capture error_code and route/model_version as dimensions.

julio: rollout plan: feature-flag `err_msg_i18n_v2`. Canary 5% for internal orgs first, then 25% beta, monitor hint_shown and fallback_locale_used as primary signals. If fallback_locale_used > 10% for EU locales after 48h we pause and prioritize translations.

ops-bot: deploy-check — canary pipeline for console/ui passed on staging at 2026-03-19T14:02Z.

elaine: small note on copy: localized snippets must avoid technical terms. e.g. instead of "quota_exceeded" user text: "Rate limit reached — try again in a few seconds." Keep developer_hint for logs only.

alex: SDK change: add Error.user_message (optional) and Error.i18n_key (required). If i18n_key present and no user_message, client should render using localizer or fallback to Error.code -> english copy. I'll open a PR for the Python/JS SDKs.

priya: docs playbook: publish a table of error codes + suggested user phrasing + console placement (inline vs modal). Also document how to use retry_after and when to show escalate buttons.

matt: one more thing — for 429 we should include quota_window and quota_name in telemetry so we can recommend quantization/optimization in Optimize.

julio: action items: (1) alex PR for SDK contract, (2) matt update runtime mapping table + telemetry schema, (3) priya + content write the localization keys and docs table, (4) elaine coordinate UI copy + feature flag rollout.

elaine: thanks everyone. I'll TL:DR and add to the rollout checklist. :thumbsup:
